claims.statement: For F_0=A(mask56242) and F_{k+1}=A(F_k^{tensor 4}), the normalized threshold c_{F_k}(eta) converges to a finite affine function of eta. At eta=1/4 the exact depth-four witness satisfies c_{F_4}>2.18.
claims.prior_bound: Every universal SMR(c,1/4) theorem required c>2.1338.
claims.new_bound: Every universal SMR(c,1/4) theorem requires c>2.18.
claims.scope: One explicit iterated fair/disjoint tensor-suspension tower; necessary bound for SMR, not GU.
